narrative: Email claiming to be University Ethics Board requiring protocol audit.

message.body: Mandatory IRB Compliance Audit: Your active study protocol requires re-authorization. Upload study data at http://irb-audit-upload.org

evidence.label: University Research Ethics Portal
evidence.value: University IRB site shows all protocol approvals active with no audit required.

consequence_text.safe: You verified protocol status on the university IRB portal and confirmed no audit was pending.
consequence_text.unsafe: Uploading data to external audit links exposes research data to unauthorized parties.

teaching_point: Transfer strategy: Verify institutional compliance audits via internal university portals.
